descriptions.normal: A large fish steak. The steak has been cured and placed on a wooden slat before smoking. Not only does the final product preserve the fish's physical integrity, but it also boasts a unique smoky flavor.
descriptions.suspicious: A large fish steak. The acrid scent of smoke triggers an immediate aversion. After taking a reluctant bite, the overpowering saltiness makes it impossible to savor, leaving no choice but to swallow it quickly to avoid waste.
descriptions.delicious: A large fish steak. The tender fish dissolves effortlessly on the tongue, combining savory notes with a hint of sweetness, while the smoky fragrance lingers, delivering a perfect finale to this flavorful delight.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1000 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 8% of Max HP and an additional 800 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1200 HP to the selected character.
